World's first skull treatment given to one-year-old baby

A one-year-old child has received the world's first medical treatment for a rare skull condition. The procedure involved the use of "super-elastic springs" to reshape the infant's skull. This innovative treatment marks a significant advancement in pediatric neurosurgery.
